cover_subtitle: Turn any PDF into a searchable Q&A bot in seconds

slides.title: Why the default fails
slides.body: → Claude returns text only. → No reference to where the info lives. → You can’t verify or cite it.

slides.title: The prompt that fixes it
slides.body: → Tell Claude you’re uploading a PDF. → Ask for concise answers. → Require “Source: page X” at the end of every reply.

slides.title: How to use it
slides.body: 1️⃣ Upload your PDF in Claude’s UI. 2️⃣ Paste the prompt above. 3️⃣ Ask any question about the document.

slides.title: Example query
slides.body: “What are the late‑payment fees?” → Claude replies: “Late‑payment fees are 2% per month. Source: page 12.”

slides.title: Tips for best results
slides.body: • Use clear, short questions. • Keep PDFs under 10 MB for faster responses. • Verify the page numbers if the doc has complex layouts.
